prerequisites.rationale: Without the ability to write executable Python, the learner cannot produce the code transformation required by obj-bpdp-01 or attempt asmt-bpdp-f01 or asmt-bpdp-s01. Instruction on transformation techniques cannot reasonably begin if the learner cannot execute Python at all; the failure is structural, not merely a performance gap.

prerequisites.capability: tabular data concepts (rows, columns, data types)
prerequisites.rationale: Identifying and scoping invalid values (nulls, type mismatches, out-of-range entries) requires understanding of column structure and data types. Without this, the learner cannot recognize which values are invalid or declare a transformation scope, which is the required entry action for obj-bpdp-01 and the conceptual substrate of obj-bpdp-02.

obj-bpdp-02 success criterion 1 and asmt-bpdp-s01 evidence criterion ev-s01-03 require the learner to reference at least one named data-quality criterion per transformation decision. Without any prior familiarity with such criteria, the learner cannot produce an externally-grounded justification; the evidence threshold cannot be met. Researcher must confirm whether minimal awareness is a required entry condition or is intended to be taught within the session.

modules.title: Identifying and Transforming Invalid Values in Python
Justifying Transformation Decisions Against Data-Quality Criteria

planning_warnings.rationale: The 60-minute total budget must accommodate both instructional delivery and two model-proposed assessments (asmt-bpdp-f01 formative in mod-bpdp-01; asmt-bpdp-s01 summative integrating both objectives at the close of mod-bpdp-02). The per-module time split (30 min each) and the instruction-to-assessment ratio within each module are model-proposed and unconfirmed. If assessment execution time alone approaches the per-module allocation, instructional scope within that module will require reduction. Researcher confirmation of the intended time allocation across instruction and assessment is required before treating these estimates as planning constraints.

sequencing_rationale: mod-bpdp-01 is placed first because obj-bpdp-01 (procedural application) is a declared prerequisite of obj-bpdp-02 in the supplied objectives artifact; the learner must produce a transformation before justifying it.

mod-bpdp-02 is placed second to build directly on the applied transformation produced in mod-bpdp-01; the summative assessment asmt-bpdp-s01 integrates both objectives and is intended to follow both modules.

prereq-bpdp-03 (data quality criteria awareness) is assigned to mod-bpdp-02 rather than the course-level entry condition because it is structurally required only at the justification step; researcher must confirm whether it is a verified entry condition for the whole course or is to be introduced within mod-bpdp-02.

The intra-module dependency between mod-bpdp-01 and mod-bpdp-02 is expressed through sequencing order; the underlying objective dependency (obj-bpdp-01 as prerequisite of obj-bpdp-02) cannot be represented in prerequisite_refs per schema constraints.

assumption_notes: Two-module structure is model-proposed based on the two supplied objectives and their declared dependency relationship; researcher should confirm whether a different module count or grouping is preferred.
Per-module time allocation of 30 minutes each is model-proposed; no time split is specified in the brief.
All three prerequisites are candidate entry conditions per their supplied status; researcher must confirm which are verified entry conditions versus capabilities to be introduced within the session.
lesson_ids are left empty in all modules for downstream orchestration to derive after lesson generation.
Assessment time for asmt-bpdp-f01 and asmt-bpdp-s01 is assumed to be included within the 60-minute total budget; the instruction-to-assessment ratio is unspecified and model-proposed.

review_instructions.overview: Review the complete instructional-design proposal once before scoring. Evaluate machine validity separately from pedagogical quality.
review_instructions.scoring_scale: Use 1-5 for every dimension: 1 poor, 3 mixed/acceptable, 5 strong.
review_instructions.mandatory_question: Ignoring machine traceability or schema issues, is this instructional design pedagogically reasonable? Answer YES, PARTIALLY, or NO with a short rationale.
blinding_rules: Do not infer how the proposal was generated.
Do not assume a machine observation means the design is pedagogically poor.
Do not repair the design while scoring; record edit effort separately.
